raj: Pushing Rainier-11b through the onboarding checklist. ran quant sweep (fp16 / int8 / int6) on our standard slices. short summary below.
elaine: nice — can you post the unit-econ numbers for chat vs batch?
raj: sure. per-1k tokens (approx): fp16 $0.32, int8 $0.18, int6 $0.12. latency median: fp16 85ms, int8 120ms, int6 160ms. tail (p95): fp16 240ms, int6 520ms.
sam: what about quality? any regression on summarization / instruction-following?
raj: flagged a consistent drop on the summarization slice when moving to int6 — ROUGE-L down ~3.8 pts vs fp16, and abstractiveness errors up. int8 is pretty close to fp16 (0.6 pts).
kelly: what's the cost delta for our typical GTN customers? if we route everything to int6 we'd save ~62% on tokens but may harm product retention.
raj: ran a quick sim using our slice weights. blended cost-per-request (chat-length 800 tokens): fp16 $0.256, int8 $0.144, int6 $0.096. expected risk-adjusted cost saving if we keep int8 for longform and int6 only for short prompts ~35%.
elaine: can you paste the bench command you used? want to reproduce quickly.
raj: sure:
```
./bench_runner --model rainier-11b --quant=int6,int8,fp16 --slices summarization,instruction,longform,search --metrics rouge,exact_match,latency,cost --out=rainier_sweep.json
```
bench-bot: sweep complete. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-onboard/rainier/5187654321/
sam: did you check priming sensitivity? int6 looks worse on primed multi-turns, correct?
raj: yes — on multi-turn priming the int6 error rate climbs, esp for entity consistency. int8 matches fp16 on priming.
kelly: product ask: recommend a rollout plan for GTN. I'm thinking canary split traffic by intent: search/rerank -> int6, assistant longform -> int8/fp16, with automatic rollback on quality evals.
elaine: +1. add continuous eval hooks on the summarization slice and a small manual review for primed multi-turn every day for first week.
sam: for pricing guidance to GTN, propose default model = rainier-int8 with optional cost-tiered fallback to rainier-int6 for inexpensive intents. include an explicit SLI for summary fidelity.
raj: agreed. I'll create a one-pager with the scorecard: (a) unit econ table, (b) delta ROUGE, (c) recommended traffic split and rollout flags, (d) monitoring queries.
kelly: timeline? need to hand to GTN by EOD tomorrow.
raj: draft ready in ~3 hours, will ping channel. :thumbsup:
bench-bot: artifact verification OK. SHA256: 9f2c...ab1e
elaine: thanks — this reads actionable. tagging @product for visibility. :eyes:
